Anna — thanks, and glad the demo was useful.

Short answers up front: we can aim for a Sept 3 internal go/no-go and for a customer-facing start week of Sept 13, pending sign-offs listed below. I'll attach a consolidated MAP + SOW and call out the minimal exit criteria for the decision.

Proposed decision checklist (what Redwood needs completed by Sept 3):
1) Legal: final review of SOW and commercial terms (ProcureCo or AsterTech legal)
2) Security: SOC2 evidence bundle & infra diagram delivered to your security team
3) PO or signed SOW via e-sign (DocuSign)
4) Technical readiness: scheduling for 1-day runbook handoff (CS/SE availability)

I've copied Kimberly to confirm legal timeline and Irene to scope the runbook and onboarding day.

I'll circulate a consolidated package (MAP v3 + SOW draft) by EOD Aug 18 so you have time to route. Is Sept 3 a hard deadline on your side or flexible by a few business days if ProcureCo needs extra time?

Thanks,
